source_snapshot.items: AMD GPU Filed Health check - Level 3 (agfhc)
source_snapshot.procedure: Extract and install the distro-specific AGFHC archive, then run `sudo ./agfhc -r all_lvl3` for approximately 30 minutes.
source_snapshot.criteria: Preserve the referenced log directory; PASS requires the exact terminal message `Program exiting with return code AGFHC_SUCCESS [0]`, while failure output contains the summary, total time, log directory and non-success code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; uses an opportunistic install and truncates the decisive suite output to 30 lines, then asks for IOMMU/driver evidence instead of full AGFHC results.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires authorized signed artifact, controlled privileged install/rollback, complete all_lvl3 results/logs, telemetry and recovery.

old_problem: The active review kept the case pending for artifact, install and environment approval even though AMD now publicly documents AGFHC recipe semantics, all_lvl3's approximately 30-minute scope, detailed logs/results and success/failure reporting. Those missing values are approval-gated prerequisites, not unresolved test semantics.
disposition_reason: AMD documents AGFHC as a structured GPU health framework covering PCIe, HBM, compute, power/thermal and fabric, lists `all_lvl3` as an approximately 30-minute whole-system recipe, and requires full result/log evaluation. AMD also states AGFHC is authorization-controlled rather than publicly downloadable. ED-03 permits exact artifact/platform bindings as configuration, ED-14 preserves the full level-3 duration, ED-15 requires the actual success result, and ED-16/ED-17 gate high-load privileged install and recovery. The review is complete without guessing a package or executing it.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row407 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2999 and its unique source identity.
Applied AMD AGFHC documentation confirming structured recipes, full detailed logs/results and `all_lvl3` as an approximately 30-minute system check.
Recognized AGFHC's authorization requirement and treated the exact archive/checksum/license/user guide as a mandatory package prerequisite, not an engineering-decision blocker.
Retained the privileged install and complete all_lvl3 execution; opportunistic install, tail truncation and IOMMU lines cannot substitute for full suite results.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row408 and verified its manifest identity; no install, AGFHC load or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Authorized AGFHC all_lvl3 installation transaction and complete 30-minute health validation
test_case.purpose: Install the exact authorized platform/distro AGFHC build under a controlled rollback plan, run the complete all_lvl3 system-health recipe once and preserve every per-GPU/subtest result and diagnostic artifact.
required_package: AMD-authorized signed AGFHC archive, checksum/license and matching user guide for the exact GPU platform and distro
Compatible ROCm/AMDGPU, RVS prerequisite, firmware, OS/kernel and IOMMU configuration matrix
Installer manifest, privilege scope, current `/opt/amd/agfhc` backup/ownership/capacity and uninstall/restore procedure
Stable GPU serial/UUID/BDF topology and signed all_lvl3 recipe listing/test-info for the pinned build
Dedicated approximately 30-minute load window, independent management, cooling/power/RAS/thermal abort thresholds and recovery
test_case.test_command: After verifying the authorized archive signature/checksum and compatibility, preserve the existing installation/config/log manifest and review the installer delta. Under separate install approval, extract the exact archive and run its documented installer once. Confirm `agfhc --list` and `--recipe-info all_lvl3`, then under high-load approval execute `/opt/amd/agfhc/agfhc -r all_lvl3 -o <approved_output_dir>` once with default system monitoring and complete stdout/stderr capture. Preserve terminal summary, exit status, results.json and every referenced log; compare pre/post GPU/RAS/dmesg/thermal/power health and restore the prior installation if required.
test_case.expected_result: The approved build installs only its signed manifest, exposes the expected all_lvl3 recipe, completes the full approximately 30-minute run on every mapped GPU, records all required subtests without silent skip, returns the exact documented success status/code 0 only when all required results pass, produces complete logs/results.json, and causes no disallowed RAS, dmesg, thermal, power or system event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authorized artifact/compatibility and install-diff evidence, complete untruncated all_lvl3 stdout/stderr, actual process exit status 0, `AGFHC_SUCCESS [0]`, complete results.json/log directory, all required GPU/subtest coverage and clean health telemetry. A tail excerpt, shell pipeline status, IOMMU lines or absent log artifacts cannot pass.
safety_gate: Do not obtain AGFHC from an unapproved source; verify authorization, signature/checksum, platform and distro compatibility
Review and back up the privileged installer footprint before mutation; do not opportunistically install based only on `command -v`
Run only in a dedicated window with independent management and verified cooling/power headroom
Keep AGFHC system monitoring/RAS/dmesg checks enabled unless a separately signed procedure says otherwise; preserve historical logs
Abort on GPU loss/reset, RAS/dmesg failure, thermal/power limit, hang, storage exhaustion or access loss; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: AGFHC archive signature/checksum/license/user-guide and OS/ROCm/driver/firmware/IOMMU compatibility record
Installer manifest, before/after filesystem/package/service diff and rollback owner
Pinned build's all_lvl3 recipe listing/info and exact command/environment
Complete stdout/stderr, process exit status, terminal summary, results.json and full log bundle
Per-GPU/subtest coverage plus synchronized RAS/dmesg/thermal/power telemetry
test_case.recovery: On install mismatch, restore the saved package/files/ownership/services before any test. On all_lvl3 fault, stop according to the vendor guide, preserve the full output/log directory and telemetry, verify every GPU and management path, restore only approved temporary settings and escalate. Do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: DeepSeek targets the same all_lvl3 workflow but truncates and misdirects evidence; the Master full install/run/result coverage remains authoritative.

blocked.reason: AMD documents the recipe, duration and result model; authorization, compatible artifact, install scope and window are execution prerequisites.
